g.title: scaler_anisotropic
g.text: mip pyramid built in hardware (2x2 box filter), trilinear sampling with up to 16 probes along the major axis
1 probe per clock: an output pixel takes NP clocks (one for trilinear) - latency: one input frame + mip build (about W*H/3 clocks)
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: regbus
g.text: AW and W in any order, OKAY responses

g.title: ctrl
g.text: capture FSM: SOF / EOL checks, writes the

g.title: levels
g.text: L0 = input frame (written by the capture)
L1 .. L4: each half the size of the last
each level gives a 2x2 window per clock

g.title: build
g.text: read the 2x2 block of level k at (2x, 2y)
wait for the last write of the level;
then next level, or start sampling
produce the output frame; back to
G_IDLE when the last pixel is accepted

g.title: dda
g.text: exact accumulation, SOF / EOL / EOF flags
stalls with the pipeline (adv), hold for LINE_BUF

g.title: probe
g.text: the DDA advances once per pixel

g.title: lodsel
g.text: lvl_a = L, lvl_b = L + 1 (top level: f = 0)
-> window origin and phases per level

g.title: samp
g.text: 8 stages (A B W M1 S1 M2 S2 M3) + output stage
window origins of both levels; RAM data
level windows after the level muxes
accumulate over the probes of a pixel
